contribution.position: I hold my earlier position. Product says reliability is settled because nobody else raised it, but that is silence, not evidence. artifact:incident-log still shows a 30-day error rate of 3.2% against a 1% SLO and two sev2 incidents, and none of the other roles' artifacts address it. The cost sheet covers budget only. QA's test-report (412 passed, 0 failed) shows functional correctness, not error-rate impact. Ops' runbook covers deploy and rollback, which limits blast radius but does not repair an existing SLO breach. The artifact list has a gap: nothing links the change to the sev2 root causes, and nothing states remaining error-budget headroom. Until those two items exist, reliability stays open. If they appear and show the change avoids the failure modes and fits the budget, I would update.
